description: This file contains functions related to PHY patch management for Realtek network devices. It includes functions for translating patch operations, applying patches to hardware, and processing patch data for specific PHY configurations.

methods.name: uint8 phy_patch_op_translate(uint8 patch_mode,uint8 patch_op,uint8 compare_op)
methods.description: Translates the patch operation based on the compare operation and patch mode.

methods.name: int32 phy_patch_op(rt_phy_patch_db_t * pPhy_patchDb,uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_op,uint16 portmask,uint16 pagemmd,uint16 addr,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint16 data,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Applies a specific patch operation to the PHY hardware.

methods.name: int32 _phy_patch_process(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,rtk_hwpatch_t * pPatch,int32 size,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Processes and applies a list of hardware patches, handling errors and logging.

methods.name: int32 phy_patch(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Main function to apply initial patch data to PHY, selecting between sequence and comparison tables.
